newsitem.title: USA: AIG unit offers new insurance products.
newsitem.headline: AIG unit offers new insurance products.

text.p: American International Underwriters, the international property-casualty operation of American International Group Inc said Monday that it will offer employee accident coverage to its fleet insurance program.

Under the new offering, said the company, occupants of an insured overseas fleet vehicle involved in an accident can now be covered for personal accidents and personal loss of reimbursement coverages, as well as emergency assistamnce.

The new coverage, Fleet Plus, is availalbe to U.S. and Canadian multinational corporations with fleet vehicles in the United Kingdom, Ireland and continental Europe that utilize its Master Controlled Internatiuonal Auto Insurance Program, said the company.

In separate news, AIG also said that it is offering its risk management information system, IntelliRisk, to U.S. based multinational commerical auto, wrokers'scompensation and general liability policyholders. The system provides access to claim and payment information.
